rpc_note: eth_call and eth_getCode pinned to the finalized block below, batched over publicnode, drpc and mevblocker; the historical eth_getLogs scan ran on https://rpc.mevblocker.io in 10,000-block chunks; every indexed event was re-read from its eth_getTransactionReceipt on publicnode

observations.label: estate-1590
observations.method: eth_getBlockByNumber finalized; eth_call and eth_getCode at that block number; factory getHooksTemplates, getMarketsForHooksTemplate, getHooksInstancesForBorrower over every registered borrower, getHooksTemplateForInstance, isHooksInstance, getMarketsForHooksInstance; arch controller getRegisteredBorrowers and getRegisteredMarkets; each market hooks(), borrower(), name(), version(); each hooks instance borrower(), name(), version(), getPullProviders(), getPushProviders(); each contract provider isPullProvider() and name()

observations.label: factory-event-history
observations.method: eth_getLogs address=HooksFactory from block 21788182 to the head at query time in 10,000-block chunks (422 chunks, 129 logs); the same 129 logs were listed by the Blockscout v2 address-logs API and each was matched by address, topics, data, block number and block hash against its eth_getTransactionReceipt

observations.label: creation-receipts
observations.method: eth_getTransactionReceipt, eth_getTransactionByHash and eth_getBlockByNumber for the creation transaction of every estate contract; creation transactions came from the Blockscout address record and, for the five contracts the operations account created directly, agree with cast compute-address over that account's nonce
